metadata.description: Private marketplace for the frontend team's Claude Code plugins. Distributes versioned subagents (repo-explorer, frontend-reviewer, test-runner, prod-readiness, 25-item verifier) and skills (component-conventions, pr-prep, pm-clarify, loop-engineering) across team repos.

plugins.name: frontend-team
plugins.description: Frontend team agents (repo-explorer, frontend-reviewer, test-runner, prod-readiness, verifier) and skills (component-conventions, pr-prep, pm-clarify, loop-engineering). React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Axios + CSS Modules + Jest/RTL + Playwright conventions inlined. Verifier now 25 items with baked-in Security + SRE gates; prod-readiness fires on plans tagged sensitive:*.
